sift-128.title: BIGANN SIFT descriptors
sift-128.description: The classic ANN reference set: 128-dimensional uint8 SIFT descriptors from the BIGANN corpus (big-ann-benchmarks 2021 distribution), searched under squared euclidean distance. Loaded as float32 in every engine. Official 10K query set.

wiki-v3-1024.title: Cohere Wikipedia 2023-11, embed-multilingual-v3
wiki-v3-1024.description: Paragraph embeddings of Wikipedia from Cohere's embed-multilingual-v3 model, 1024 dimensions, unit-normalized (prepare measures norm 1.0), searched by inner product, which equals cosine here. Seven languages interleaved in 10k-row chunks so every prefix is multilingual.
